Yes. Program sometimes, code sometimes, for we are building the primitives to make the world of programs. So they themselves may not be the same unit, but as we descend into the realm of code, we look upon the code just as artistically as something built upon the primitives. We look upon how the core archetypal foundations of building applications is.

What I just told my CV making session mid writing:

> I'll say you're probably going to CV. I said he's right now. The intro is given perhaps too little attention. There's more I want to say. And what I have to say matters a lot. For I'm not going to use my CV to take a job I don't want. This is the primary rule of the CV. Only provide what I want. To those that I want to work with. And I already talk about potential. In the idea. In what compounds. Is what I say. So what I have to contribute are my dreams, my vision, which is compounding. Which would co-compound, so to say, potency, feeds potency. And perhaps I need to package that. Which I do. Into something nameable. Are we ultimately perhaps talking about large language models and their ontological relationship to pure functional compute?

Yes of course field of a holon are contact point for prose, so that we can in fact build ontologically upon the fields. For where each holon connects are at the ontological connectors, forming larger ontology.
body.title: Fields as connectors
